content.objective: Let registered members open the community fridge with their badge while the kiosk keeps the daily take guideline, door state and available inventory under control.
content.outcome: Members get food through a badge-controlled door, over-limit takes are visible without denying access, the door is not silently left open, and the available inventory count excludes expired items.

description.value:
Objective: Let registered members open the community fridge with their badge while the kiosk keeps the daily take guideline, door state and available inventory under control.

Context: The kiosk sits on the fridge door, validates badges, must keep working when connectivity is lost, and relies on volunteers to flag expired food.

In scope

  • Badge unlock for registered members and rejection of unknown or deactivated badges
  • Daily take limit of 3 items with recording and warning on a fourth item, without lockout
  • Audible alert when the door stays open for more than 60 seconds
  • Offline badge checks against the last synchronized member list and upload of events when connectivity returns
  • Volunteers marking items as expired and removing them from the available inventory count

Out of scope

  • Payments and donations tracking

Expected outcome: Members get food through a badge-controlled door, over-limit takes are visible without denying access, the door is not silently left open, and the available inventory count excludes expired items.
